title: IT Technical Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support EngineerJob Overview

We are looking for a skilled **Technical Support Engineer** to provide technical assistance to customers, troubleshoot software and system issues, and ensure a smooth user experience. The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills, technical knowledge, and excellent communication abilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **technical support** to customers through email, chat, phone, and support tickets.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software, application, API, and system\-related issues.
* Investigate reported problems and identify the root cause.
* Reproduce bugs and work with development teams to resolve technical issues.
* Monitor and troubleshoot **API failures, integration issues, and data\-related problems**.
* Assist customers with account, configuration, access, and product\-related issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to development, DevOps, or engineering teams when required.
* Maintain accurate records of customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
* Create and maintain **technical documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides**.
* Monitor recurring issues and suggest improvements to reduce support requests.
* Test fixes and verify that reported issues have been resolved.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the resolution process.
* Assist with system monitoring and basic production support activities.

Required Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of **web applications, APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, and databases**.
* Basic knowledge of **Linux, networking, DNS, and cloud environments**.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as **Postman**.
* Ability to read and understand application logs and error messages.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and database troubleshooting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple support requests.
* Familiarity with ticketing and support management systems.

Good to Have

* Experience with **Node.js, JavaScript, React**, or other web technologies.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, Docker, or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
* Understanding of Git and software development workflows.
* Experience supporting SaaS products or B2B technology platforms.
* IT support or technical certifications.

Experience

**1–4 years** of experience in technical support, application support, software support, or a related field.

What We’re Looking For

A customer\-focused technical professional who can **diagnose issues quickly, communicate solutions clearly, collaborate with engineering teams, and ensure customer problems are resolved efficiently**.

Pay: ₹9,509\.67 \- ₹40,160\.25 per month

Work Location: In person
